verdict.rationale: Otter documents admin-side visibility through audit trails, activity logs and SSO-based access control, and offers Channels as shared team spaces. However, nothing documents granular link, folder or workspace sharing permissions. Community reports say notes are shared with all meeting participants by default, which is the opposite of private-by-default. missing for 10: private-by-default notes (community reports default sharing to all attendees), documented granular link/folder/workspace permission controls, explicit admin visibility into what specifically is shared, independent corroboration of the admin controls.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sharing is controlled — private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permissions, and admin visibility into what's shared

citations.quote: Maintain visibility into account activity with audit trails and logging, supporting your security, compliance, and regulatory reporting needs.
Enhanced admin features: activity logs, usage analytics, and more
Easily control access with secure identity tools like Okta, Azure AD, and others.
Meetings grouped by team, project, or topic so everyone can find recordings and collaborate in one shared space.
